newsitem.title: USA: "Con Air" takes off in top place at box office.
newsitem.headline: "Con Air" takes off in top place at box office.

text.p: The Nicolas Cage action movie "Con Air" flew to the top of the weekend U.S. box office, according to studio estimates released on Sunday.
The picture, in which Cage plays a paroled prisoner aboard a plane commandeered by a bunch of psychotic crooks, earned about $25.5 million for the Friday to Sunday period.

The No. 1 movie for the previous two weekends, "The Lost World: Jurassic Park," slipped to second with $18.5 million. Also down a notch, to third, was the romantic comedy "Addicted to Love" with about $3.8 million.
The figures were provided by Exhibitor Relations Co., which collects the estimates from the studios.
For the second week in a row, and just the fourth time this year, the overall box office was lower than the year-ago period. Final figures will be released on Monday.

Rounding out the top five was "Buddy," a new entry starring Rene Russo, who raises a chimp as a member of her household. It earned a paltry $3.7 million. "Gone Fishin'," a comedy that debuted last weekend, slipped two places to fifth with $3.1 million.

"Con Air" and "Gone Fishin'" are released by Walt Disney Co.. "The Lost World: Jurassic Park" is released by Universal Pictures, a unit of Seagram Co. Ltd.. "Addicted To Love" is released by Warner Bros, a unit of Time Warner Inc.. "Buddy" is released by Columbia Pictures, a unit of Sony Corp..
